Amir: Quick flag — vendor HelioServe sent a dispute on INV-2025-612 for $6,420. They claim duplicate invoice. Payment is 22 days overdue.

Leah: Do we have matching PO / remittance for both invoices?

Jon: I checked — two invoices were generated due to retry after a webhook timeout; second should have been suppressed.

Sophie: Can we void the duplicate and issue credit memo? Client says they'll pay once corrected.

Legal - Priya: Fine to void if docs support it. Need internal note explaining root cause and authorization to issue credit.

collections-bot: Invoice INV-2025-612 | Overdue 22d | Balance $6,420 | Recommend: void duplicate, issue credit memo, request payment within 5 business days.

Amir: Leah/Jon please attach support docs to BILL-4938 and issue memo. Hold off on dunning after credit sent.

Leah: On it. I'll update the ticket and DM finance the credit memo PDF for records.
